chapter_title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Pro
spiritual_reading:
All the instruction, affection, and knowledge a person receives and makes part of life is taken up into the inner human, and from that appropriation it is set in order into a sufficient series of effects.

The first effect is an outflow that arises when the person is lifted above the ordinary state into interior perception, and it ascends into the ruling understanding. It then diffuses through all the powers of life in the whole person, and its extension cannot be measured because it reaches as far as the person’s reception allows.

The second effect is an outflow that comes forth as communicated truth, when what is within passes into expressed meaning and ordered utterance.

The third effect is an outflow that becomes actual power for use, when inward intention passes into vigor, execution, and accomplished works.

The fourth effect is an outflow that is generated from merely natural delight separated from higher love, when the will is kindled by impure pleasure and seeks conjunction on that level.

The fifth effect is an outflow that is fixed in the outermost degree as a new formed life in the natural plane, brought into determinate existence from its origins. This is a life in the lowest level, and only those who were the immediate source of it can distinctly acknowledge it as theirs. They attend to its tendencies, its thinking, and its love continually, without ceasing. Yet the other four effects they do not perceive and do not care for, because these do not appear outwardly in the senses.
assessment: Both lacunae are trivial mid-word restorations tightly fixed by the surrounding text: ¶6 requires the single letter to complete “lust,” and ¶7 requires the two letters to complete “love.” No alternative readings fit the correspondential structure or the natural phrasing.
